Title: MCP Context Pack Tool
Content: MemorySmith.App now exposes memorysmith_context_pack for larger knowledge-base workflows. The tool can start from hybrid search query roots, explicit comma-separated root ids, or both, then packages each root result with linked references and conflicts up to a bounded reference depth. It can also include backlinks: records that reference or conflict with packed records. Each packed record includes relationship, status, confidence, tags, references, conflicts, score or linked-context marker, match reason, and truncated content. The pack reports warnings for missing or invalid explicit ids, missing linked records, and maxRecords budget truncation. Use maxRecords to keep large-KB output bounded. Use format=json when an agent needs structured parsing instead of Markdown; the default output remains Markdown. Search probes for mcp context pack format json markdown should resolve to this focused context-pack record. Use ids when an agent already has promising memory ids and query when discovering new roots; this reduces manual search/get chaining when an agent needs enough project-wiki context to plan or review a change.
